description: Browse CPIC recommendations in drug mode with one exact drugName or drugId. Match across drugs in results mode with geneResults or geneSymbol plus phenotype/activityScore, or genotype mode with 1–10 uniquely resolved gene/diplotype entries. Both matching modes accept an optional drug. Optional view=test_alerts selects complete example CDS alerts instead of recommendations, without joins; default view=recommendations. Alert records retain ordered alerttext, No CDS and n/a. Use pgx_list_reference topic phenotypes for source values. Every matched prerequisite must be explicit; omitted genes are never normal, negative or No Result. Preserve populations, scores, classifications and source text. Follow page.nextOffset and incompletePage.nextOffset independently for the selected collection and missing-gene diagnostics; consult source guidelines before clinical use.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_selector`: Selectors are missing, conflicting, blank or mixed between modes. `gene_required`: A scalar result cannot identify a unique gene. `ambiguous_drug`: An exact drug name identifies several drug records. `unsupported_gene_result`: A supplied result kind is incompatible with source gene semantics, or its value is unsupported or ambiguous. `query_too_broad`: An internal bounded scan or attempt budget is exceeded. `upstream_query_rejected`: CPIC rejects the generated query. `upstream_rate_limited`: CPIC rate limits requests. `upstream_unavailable`: The source is unavailable or returns maintenance HTML. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
